requirements_summary: Primary workloads: conversational assistants (context windows ~1-2k tokens), product search embeddings (batch upserts + low-latency similarity queries), reranking for recommendations. Ops must run in VPC with customer KMS. Strong cost sensitivity vs OpenAI/Anthropic managed endpoints; want deterministic throughput during holiday peaks. SLOs are negotiable but engineering target = p95 <= 200ms for short chat replies (~50 tokens), p95 <= 800ms for longer responses (~500-800 tokens). Need throughput guarantees (baseline and burst) with documented fallback model variants.
baseline_qps: steady-state target 25 QPS (chat) across ~300 concurrent sessions; embeddings batch jobs 6 QPS equivalent during off-peak; observed baseline on-sample ~18-22 QPS without batching; concurrency expected to grow with holiday windows.
baseline_tokens_per_sec: baseline aggregate ~1,800 tokens/sec (chat avg 150 tokens/request); embeddings throughput measured separately (tokens not applicable).
peak_qps: peak planning: 120 QPS sustained for 30min (flash sales), 400 QPS instantaneous burst for 2-3 minutes — need warm pool + burst capacity plan.
steady_state_qps: steady-state planning: 25 QPS with headroom 2.5x; target provisioning to hit p95 latency SLOs under steady load.
latency_slos: Target SLOs (customer requested): p95 <= 200ms for 50-token chat responses; p95 <= 800ms for 500-800 token generations; availability 99.95% monthly for dedicated cluster. Redwood proposed: 99.9% initial SLA + credits discussion.
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial recommendation (preliminary): reserve 8 x A100-80GB equivalent nodes (in Dedicated pool) to meet steady-state + small headroom; configure autoscale burst to 12 nodes for peak blasts. Consider mixed instance types: 6x higher-memory for long context models and 2x cheaper GPUs for reranking/embeddings. Re-evaluate after 6-week load tests.
sla_negotiation_points: Open items: uptime target (customer asks 99.95%), SLA credits formula, maintenance window policies (no major updates during Black Friday window), data residency and e-discovery commitments, escalation matrix & RTO for degraded performance, committed token pricing for reserved nodes, and termination rights if perf regressions occur after model upgrades.
